SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
INSERT INTO cris_test_runs (run_key, delivery_mode, allow_public_messages, requested_windows, scenario_groups, input, created_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::boolean, $4::text[], $5::text[], $6::jsonb, $7) ON CONFLICT (run_key) DO UPDATE SET delivery_mode = EXCLUDED.delivery_mode, allow_public_messages = EXCLUDED.allow_public_messages, requested_windows = EXCLUDED.requested_windows, scenario_groups = EXCLUDED.scenario_groups, input = EXCLUDED.input, status = 'RUNNING', summary = '{}'::jsonb, error = NULL, started_at = now(), finished_at = NULL, updated_at = now() RETURNING id AS run_id, run_key, delivery_mode, allow_public_messages, requested_windows, scenario_groups;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS leads), requested AS (SELECT value AS request, NULLIF(value->>'phone', '') AS requested_phone, NULLIF(value->>'marca', '') AS requested_marca, CASE WHEN value ? 'lead_id' AND value->>'lead_id' <> '' THEN (value->>'lead_id')::uuid ELSE NULL END AS requested_lead_id, CASE WHEN value ? 'conversation_id' AND value->>'conversation_id' <> '' THEN (value->>'conversation_id')::uuid ELSE NULL END AS requested_conversation_id, CASE WHEN value ? 'quicklink_id' AND value->>'quicklink_id' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (value->>'quicklink_id')::integer ELSE NULL END AS requested_quicklink_id FROM input, jsonb_array_elements(input.leads) value), candidates AS (SELECT r.*, cris_qa_digits(r.requested_phone) AS requested_digits FROM requested r WHERE cris_qa_is_allowed_phone(r.requested_phone)), matched AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.requested_phone) c.request, c.requested_phone AS phone, COALESCE(lm.phone, conv.telefono, cris_qa_normalize_phone(c.requested_phone)) AS phone_e164, l.id AS lead_id, COALESCE(l.quicklink_id, conv.quicklink_id) AS quicklink_id, COALESCE(l.marca::text, conv.marca::text) AS marca, COALESCE(l.nombre_cliente, conv.nombre) AS nombre_cliente, COALESCE(l.telefono_1, conv.telefono) AS telefono_1, l.telefono_2, COALESCE(l.modelo, conv.modelo) AS modelo, l.estado_agente::text AS estado_agente, conv.id AS conversation_id, conv.estado::text AS conversation_state, conv.chatwoot_conv_id, conv.chatwoot_contact_id, lm.conversation_state AS memory_state, lm.outbound_sequence_status, lm.customer_engaged, lm.selected_plan, lm.selected_plan_name, lm.selected_plan_duration FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN leads_quicklink l ON ((c.requested_lead_id IS NOT NULL AND l.id = c.requested_lead_id) OR (c.requested_quicklink_id IS NOT NULL AND c.requested_marca IS NOT NULL AND l.quicklink_id = c.requested_quicklink_id AND l.marca::text = upper(c.requested_marca)) OR (cris_qa_digits(l.telefono_1) = c.requested_digits) OR (cris_qa_digits(l.telefono_2) = c.requested_digits) OR (c.requested_digits <> '' AND right(cris_qa_digits(l.telefono_1), length(c.requested_digits)) = c.requested_digits) OR (c.requested_digits <> '' AND right(cris_qa_digits(l.telefono_2), length(c.requested_digits)) = c.requested_digits) OR (cris_qa_normalize_phone(l.telefono_1) = cris_qa_normalize_phone(c.requested_phone))) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT cv.* FROM conversaciones cv WHERE (c.requested_conversation_id IS NOT NULL AND cv.id = c.requested_conversation_id) OR (l.conversacion_id IS NOT NULL AND cv.id = l.conversacion_id) OR (l.id IS NOT NULL AND cv.lead_id = l.id) OR (cris_qa_digits(cv.telefono) = c.requested_digits) OR (c.requested_digits <> '' AND right(cris_qa_digits(cv.telefono), length(c.requested_digits)) = c.requested_digits) ORDER BY cv.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) conv ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT mem.* FROM lead_memory mem WHERE (l.id IS NOT NULL AND mem.lead_id = l.id) OR (conv.id IS NOT NULL AND mem.conversation_id = conv.id) OR mem.phone = cris_qa_normalize_phone(c.requested_phone) OR cris_qa_digits(mem.phone) = c.requested_digits OR (c.requested_digits <> '' AND right(cris_qa_digits(mem.phone), length(c.requested_digits)) = c.requested_digits) ORDER BY mem.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) lm ON true ORDER BY c.requested_phone, conv.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, l.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT * FROM matched ORDER BY phone;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH payload AS (SELECT $14::jsonb AS j), ins AS (INSERT INTO cris_test_cases (run_id, scenario_id, scenario_group, window_profile, delivery_mode, phone, phone_e164, lead_id, conversation_id, chatwoot_conv_id, chatwoot_contact_id, expected, repro_payload, status, started_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, NULLIF($7::text, ''), NULLIF($8::text, '')::uuid, NULLIF($9::text, '')::uuid, NULLIF($10::text, '')::integer, NULLIF($11::text, '')::integer, $12::jsonb, $13::jsonb, 'RUNNING', now()) ON CONFLICT (run_id, scenario_id, window_profile, delivery_mode, phone) DO UPDATE SET status = 'RUNNING', expected = EXCLUDED.expected, repro_payload = EXCLUDED.repro_payload, started_at = now(), finished_at = NULL, error = NULL, updated_at = now() RETURNING *) SELECT ins.*, payload.j AS case_payload FROM ins CROSS JOIN payload;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH cr AS (SELECT * FROM cris_test_cases WHERE id = $1::uuid), lead_row AS (SELECT l.* FROM leads_quicklink l, cr WHERE l.id = cr.lead_id LIMIT 1), conv_row AS (SELECT c.* FROM conversaciones c, cr WHERE c.id = cr.conversation_id OR (cr.lead_id IS NOT NULL AND c.lead_id = cr.lead_id) ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1), mem_row AS (SELECT lm.* FROM lead_memory lm, cr LEFT JOIN conv_row cv ON true WHERE lm.conversation_id = cv.id OR lm.lead_id = cr.lead_id OR lm.phone = cr.phone_e164 OR cris_qa_digits(lm.phone) = cris_qa_digits(cr.phone) ORDER BY lm.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1), pending AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(sf) ORDER BY sf.scheduled_at), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM scheduled_followups sf, conv_row cv WHERE sf.conversation_id = cv.id AND sf.status = 'PENDING'), button_events AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ev) ORDER BY ev.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM (SELECT wie.* FROM whatsapp_interaction_events wie, conv_row cv WHERE wie.conversation_id = cv.id ORDER BY wie.created_at DESC LIMIT 10) ev), transfers AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(th) ORDER BY th.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM transferencias_humano th, conv_row cv WHERE th.conversation_id = cv.id) SELECT cr.*, jsonb_build_object('lead', (SELECT to_jsonb(lead_row) FROM lead_row), 'conversation', (SELECT to_jsonb(conv_row) FROM conv_row), 'memory', (SELECT to_jsonb(mem_row) FROM mem_row), 'pending_followups', (SELECT rows FROM pending), 'button_events', (SELECT rows FROM button_events), 'transfers', (SELECT rows FROM transfers)) AS snapshot_before FROM cr;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j), ins AS (INSERT INTO cris_test_outbox (run_id, case_id, delivery_mode, channel, target_phone, target_conversation_id, message_type, would_send_payload, sent, external_status, external_response) SELECT (j->>'run_id')::uuid, (j->>'id')::uuid, j->>'delivery_mode', 'whatsapp', coalesce(j->>'phone_e164', j->>'phone'), NULLIF(j->>'conversation_id', '')::uuid, j->'outbox_payload'->>'kind', j->'outbox_payload', coalesce((j->'action'->>'sent')::boolean, false), j->'action'->>'status', coalesce(j->'action'->'response_body', '{}'::jsonb) FROM input RETURNING id) SELECT input.j AS case_json, (SELECT id FROM ins) AS outbox_id FROM input;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j, $2::uuid AS outbox_id), cr AS (SELECT * FROM cris_test_cases WHERE id = (SELECT (j->>'id')::uuid FROM input)), lead_row AS (SELECT l.* FROM leads_quicklink l, cr WHERE l.id = cr.lead_id LIMIT 1), conv_row AS (SELECT c.* FROM conversaciones c, cr WHERE c.id = cr.conversation_id OR (cr.lead_id IS NOT NULL AND c.lead_id = cr.lead_id) ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1), mem_row AS (SELECT lm.* FROM lead_memory lm, cr LEFT JOIN conv_row cv ON true WHERE lm.conversation_id = cv.id OR lm.lead_id = cr.lead_id OR lm.phone = cr.phone_e164 OR cris_qa_digits(lm.phone) = cris_qa_digits(cr.phone) ORDER BY lm.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1), pending AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(sf) ORDER BY sf.scheduled_at), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM scheduled_followups sf, conv_row cv WHERE sf.conversation_id = cv.id AND sf.status = 'PENDING'), button_events AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ev) ORDER BY ev.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM (SELECT wie.* FROM whatsapp_interaction_events wie, conv_row cv WHERE wie.conversation_id = cv.id ORDER BY wie.created_at DESC LIMIT 10) ev), transfers AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(th) ORDER BY th.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM transferencias_humano th, conv_row cv WHERE th.conversation_id = cv.id), outbox AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM cris_test_outbox o, cr WHERE o.case_id = cr.id) SELECT cr.*, input.j AS case_json, input.outbox_id, jsonb_build_object('lead', (SELECT to_jsonb(lead_row) FROM lead_row), 'conversation', (SELECT to_jsonb(conv_row) FROM conv_row), 'memory', (SELECT to_jsonb(mem_row) FROM mem_row), 'pending_followups', (SELECT rows FROM pending), 'button_events', (SELECT rows FROM button_events), 'transfers', (SELECT rows FROM transfers), 'outbox', (SELECT rows FROM outbox)) AS snapshot_after FROM cr CROSS JOIN input;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j), upd AS (UPDATE cris_test_cases SET status = input.j->>'final_status', severity = NULLIF(input.j->>'final_severity', ''), actual = coalesce(input.j->'actual', '{}'::jsonb), assertions = coalesce(input.j->'assertions', '[]'::jsonb), execution_ids = coalesce(input.j->'execution_ids_final', '[]'::jsonb), snapshot_before = coalesce(input.j->'case_json'->'snapshot_before', '{}'::jsonb), snapshot_after = coalesce(input.j->'snapshot_after', '{}'::jsonb), error = NULLIF(input.j->>'final_error', ''), finished_at = now(), updated_at = now() FROM input WHERE cris_test_cases.id = (input.j->>'id')::uuid RETURNING cris_test_cases.*), finding AS (INSERT INTO cris_test_findings (run_id, case_id, severity, title, expected, actual, suspected_node, evidence, repro_payload) SELECT (input.j->>'run_id')::uuid, (input.j->>'id')::uuid, input.j->'finding'->>'severity', input.j->'finding'->>'title', coalesce(input.j->'finding'->'expected', '{}'::jsonb), coalesce(input.j->'finding'->'actual', '{}'::jsonb), input.j->'finding'->>'suspected_node', coalesce(input.j->'finding'->'evidence', '{}'::jsonb), coalesce(input.j->'finding'->'repro_payload', '{}'::jsonb) FROM input WHERE input.j ? 'finding' AND input.j->'finding' <> 'null'::jsonb RETURNING id) SELECT upd.run_id, upd.id AS case_id, upd.status, upd.severity, (SELECT id FROM finding) AS finding_id FROM upd;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
UPDATE cris_test_runs SET status = $2, summary = $3::jsonb, finished_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id AS run_id, run_key, status, summary, started_at, finished_at;

## CRIS QA - Test Orchestrator

Webhook: POST /cris-qa-run

- 0998299109
- 21999910781

Default mode: shadow.
Live sends require delivery_mode live/hybrid and allow_public_messages=true.
